purpose: Explicit current aligned and transcript inputs drive stage.split/run_bound then stage.translate/run_bound. The offline reference uses the built-in synthetic pair and does not open a socket.
input_identity: caller-supplied aligned_segments.json and transcript_segments.json, or the built-in synthetic pair when both env paths are unset
allowed_variable: REAL_CHAIN_LLM_ALIGNED and REAL_CHAIN_LLM_TRANSCRIPT select explicit files or directories. REAL_LLM_STAGES_ONLINE=1 lets run_bound execute. REAL_CHAIN_LLM_EXECUTE_REAL=1 is the only switch that runs the known real episode files; without it those files stay hash-checked and do not start stages. Speaker enroll, npz and source audio are optional explicit resources and are required together when the real switch is on. REAL_CHAIN_LLM_REUSE_SPLIT, REAL_CHAIN_LLM_REUSE_CALLS and REAL_CHAIN_LLM_REUSE_SPLIT_SHA together bind an already guarded split and add zero split requests. REAL_CHAIN_LLM_REUSE_TRANSLATE restores saved translate responses by exact prompt sha and model; cache hits are reused, not new attempts or tokens.
failure_policy: missing, bad JSON, or id/time mismatch makes zero provider calls; split failure does not call translate; translate failure does not write a successful handoff
randomness: offline reference has no provider text; stubbed tests are deterministic
cache_policy: python -B; a previous handoff is never returned as this run's success
